decisions.title: Double Eagle II Airport Master Plan
decisions.description: Guides long-term development of Double Eagle II Airport through aviation forecasts, runway and taxiway requirements, compatible land use, airside and landside alternatives, environmental review, recommended facilities, funding strategies, and a phased capital improvement program.

No smaller authoritative version was identified. Optimization could reduce map or image fidelity and is not proposed. The unchanged original is below the 100,000,000-byte approval threshold.
